SeriesStatAccessor API Reference¶

Back to Series API Reference

This page documents the handwritten SeriesStatAccessor subset reached through Series::stat.

Using This Reference¶

  • Use the left sidebar to open one method page at a time.

  • Each method page contains its own signatures, parameter details, failure cases, verified outputs, and working previous/next navigation.

  • This landing page stays intentionally short so the content panel is not one giant scroll of every statistical method at once.

Entry Surface¶

The accessor is available in two ordinary spellings:

  • dot-style convenience: x.stat.var(...), x.stat.center(...)

  • explicit proxy style: x.stat().var(...), x.stat().center(...)

For the current handwritten batch, the dot-style forms are the main examples because they are the most concise everyday spelling on the public surface.

Current Coverage¶

The current handwritten SeriesStatAccessor subset focuses on descriptive and normalization-heavy methods users typically reach first:

  • dispersion: var, std, nanvar, nanstd

  • transforms: center, standardize

  • higher moments: skewness, kurtosis

The accessor surface is wider than this. Pair-bound distance methods, density helpers, and moving-window methods should be documented in later batches rather than stubbed here without the same example rigor.
